notes.title: BIG SUMMER UPDATE
notes.content:
[p]This time we have added the following content and features:

- A new SPECIAL EVENT WEEK 2 competition group;[/p][p]- Added a new iconic muscule car prize car; [/p][p]- Finally you can turn off the Ghost glow in the game settings menu (if it was bothering you);[/p][p]- Various technical improvements and bug fixes;[/p][p]- Fixed issue in Pro competitions;[/p][p]- Increased multiplayer server capacity by 5 times;[/p][p]- Discord link was removed, we are tired of fighting with scammers.

Hope you'll enjoy the changes.[/p]

notes.title: First update
notes.content: [p]Today we released the first update for the game based on your requests and recommendations.[/p][p]What's included in the update:[/p][p]- new car control scheme[/p][p]- Photo mode added[/p][p]- added special effects[/p][p]- added screen resolution selection[/p][p]- window mode[/p][p]We hope the game has become better and will bring you more fun ;)[/p]
